feed_summary: Threat actors are delivering malicious loaders and cryptocurrency miners under the guise of artificial intelligence (AI) desktop applications for Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT as part of a campaign dubbed Yoba. title: Fake ChatGPT and Claude Apps Abuse Signed Executables to Deploy Crypto Miners
